description_en: Performs a paged query on the persisted history messages and events in a specified session with paging
description_zh: 分页查询指定会话中已持久化的历史消息和事件
name: ListCopilotSessionMessages

parameters.help_en: The agent ID retained for compatibility with historical calls. This parameter can be omitted. Currently, the entire session is queried by sessionId, and this parameter does not change the query scope of historical events
parameters.help_zh: 兼容历史调用保留的 Agent ID，可省略。当前按 sessionId 查询整个会话，该参数不改变历史事件的查询范围
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination offset retained for compatibility with historical calls. Default value: 0. For new integrations, we recommend using nextToken. Do not specify this parameter and nextToken at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 兼容历史调用的分页偏移量，默认值为 0。新接入建议使用 nextToken，不与 nextToken 同时传入
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The page size retained for compatibility with historical calls. Default value: 50. Valid values: 1 to 200. For new integrations, we recommend using maxResults. If both parameters are specified, maxResults takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 兼容历史调用的分页大小，默认值为 50，范围为 1～200。新接入建议使用 maxResults；同时传入时以 maxResults 为准
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 50. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为 50，取值范围为 1～1000
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the nextToken value from the previous response. Clear this value when you change the filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标记。首次请求不传，后续请求使用上一次响应中的 nextToken。切换筛选条件时应清空该值
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The returned status code. Success indicates that the request is successful. Other values indicate that the request failed
code.description_zh: 返回状态码。Success 表示请求成功；其他值表示请求失败

cursor.description_en: The cursor of the last event on the current page, returned as a decimal string. The value is 0 for an empty page. This is not the pagination nextToken and does not indicate that a round of execution has finished
cursor.description_zh: 本页最后一条事件的游标，以十进制字符串返回；空页为 0。不是分页 nextToken，不代表一轮执行已经结束

hasMore.description_en:
Indicates whether there are subsequent historical events. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
hasMore.description_zh: 是否还有后续历史事件。true：有；false：没有

maxResults.description_en: The page size used for the current request

messages.description_en: The history event records on the current page, sorted in ascending order by eventId. A record does not necessarily represent a complete chat message and may be a chunk of text or a tool calling (invoke) event
messages.description_zh: 当前页的历史事件记录，按 eventId 升序排列。一条记录不一定是一条完整聊天消息，可能是文本或工具调用的一个分片

items.description_en: The history event records on the current page, sorted in ascending order by eventId. A record does not necessarily represent a complete chat message and may be a chunk of text or a tool calling (invoke) event
items.description_zh: 当前页的历史事件记录，按 eventId 升序排列。一条记录不一定是一条完整聊天消息，可能是文本或工具调用的一个分片

content.description_en: The human-readable content summary of the event. To restore the complete interactive interface, use the original event in metadata
content.description_zh: 事件的人类可读内容摘要。恢复完整交互界面时请使用 metadata 中的原始事件

items.description_en: The human-readable content summary of the event. To restore the complete interactive interface, use the original event in metadata
items.description_zh: 事件的人类可读内容摘要。恢复完整交互界面时请使用 metadata 中的原始事件

text.description_en: The readable text content in the event. This field is empty if no readable string is available
text.description_zh: 事件中可读的文本内容；没有可读字符串时为空

type.description_en: The event type, such as USER_MESSAGE, TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT, or TOOL_CALL_ARGS. This is not fixed to text
type.description_zh: 事件类型，例如 USER_MESSAGE、TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT、TOOL_CALL_ARGS，不是固定的 text

createdAt.description_en: The time when the historical event record was created, in ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 历史事件记录创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

eventId.description_en: The position of the event within the session, used for sorting and deduplication
eventId.description_zh: 会话内事件位置，用于排序和去重

finishedAt.description_en: Currently, an empty string is returned. This field is not used to determine whether the execution has finished
finishedAt.description_zh: 当前返回空字符串，不用于判断执行是否结束

id.description_en: The ID of the historical event record

metadata.description_en: The complete original event object. The internal fields retain their original protocol names, without recursive naming conversion or the need for further JSON string parsing
metadata.description_zh: 完整的原始事件对象。其内部字段保留协议原名，不递归转换命名，也不需要再次进行 JSON 字符串解析

name.description_en: Currently, an empty string is returned. This field is not used to identify the event type
name.description_zh: 当前返回空字符串，不用于识别事件类型

role.description_en: The role in the original event. An empty string is returned if the event does not contain a role
role.description_zh: 原始事件中的角色。事件未包含角色时返回空字符串

turnId.description_en: The ID of the associated execution. This field is empty if there is no associated execution
turnId.description_zh: 所属执行 ID，无关联执行时为空

usage.description_en: The token usage per event. This data is not currently returned. To query the cumulative usage of an execution, call GetCopilotSession
usage.description_zh: 逐事件 Token 用量。当前不返回该数据；执行累计用量请通过 GetCopilotSession 查询

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. Pass this value back as is in the next request. An empty value indicates that there is no next page
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页标记。下一次请求时原样传回；为空表示没有下一页

session.description_en: The session summary of the current user. This object does not contain the active execution summary. To query the execution status, call GetCopilotSession
session.description_zh: 当前用户的会话摘要。该对象不包含活动执行摘要；查询执行状态请调用 GetCopilotSession

agentId.description_en: The agent identifier in the session summary, which does not represent the current executor. The current executor is subject to activeTurn.agentId
agentId.description_zh: 会话摘要中的 Agent 标记，不代表当前执行者。当前执行者以 activeTurn.agentId 为准

createdAt.description_en: The time when the session was created, in ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 会话创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

id.description_en: The session ID, which is the same as sessionId. We recommend using sessionId to initiate subsequent requests
id.description_zh: 会话 ID，与 sessionId 相同。建议使用 sessionId 发起后续请求

scheduledTask.description_en: The snapshot information when the scheduled task is triggered. This field is returned only for scheduled task sessions and is empty for sessions from other sources. Subsequent renaming or deletion of the task does not change the historical snapshot
scheduledTask.description_zh: 定时任务触发时的快照信息。仅定时任务会话返回，其他来源会话为空。任务后续改名或删除不改变历史快照

runId.description_en: The ID of this scheduled execution. Different runIds are used for multiple triggers of the same scheduled task
runId.description_zh: 本次调度执行 ID。同一定时任务的多次触发使用不同的 runId

scheduledAt.description_en: The scheduled trigger time, in ISO 8601 format with time zone. This field is empty if there is no record
scheduledAt.description_zh: 计划触发时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式。无记录时为空

startedAt.description_en: The time when Copilot started processing this schedule, in ISO 8601 format with time zone. This is not the time when the model outputs the first token
startedAt.description_zh: Copilot 开始处理本次调度的时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式。不是模型首字输出时间

taskId.description_en: The ID of the associated scheduled task

taskName.description_en: The name of the scheduled task at the time of this trigger
taskName.description_zh: 本次触发时的定时任务名称

timezone.description_en: The scheduling time zone of the scheduled task, such as Asia/Shanghai
timezone.description_zh: 定时任务的调度时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai

sessionId.description_en: The session ID. Use this value when you send follow-up questions, query history, or delete the session
sessionId.description_zh: 会话 ID。后续发送问题、查询历史和删除会话时使用此值

sessionType.description_en:
The source from which the session was created. Valid values:
openapi: Active call.
cron: Scheduled task.
im_dingtalk: DingTalk.
im_feishu: Lark.
alert: Alert.
This value is determined by the server and is not changed by follow-up questions
sessionType.description_zh: 会话创建来源。openapi：主动调用；cron：定时任务；im_dingtalk：钉钉；im_feishu：飞书；alert：告警。由服务端确定，后续追问不改变来源

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the session was last updated, in ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 会话最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

userId.description_en: The ID of the user to whom the session belongs. This value is determined by the server based on the caller identity and is not used as a parameter for the client to specify the identity
userId.description_zh: 会话所属的用户 ID。该值由服务端根据调用身份确定，不作为客户端指定身份的参数

maxResults.description_en: A field retained for historical compatibility, which may be omitted. Use data.maxResults instead
maxResults.description_zh: 历史兼容字段，可能省略。请使用 data.maxResults

message.description_en: The error message. If the code is Success, this field is empty. Otherwise, this field contains the error message of the request
message.description_zh: 错误信息。如果 code 为 Success，则本字段为空；否则本字段包含请求错误信息

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used for end-to-end diagnostics
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于全链路诊断
